experiment.go: if AssertionViolated = true [ ask patches [ set pcolor red ] user-message "Assertion violated!" stop ] if (count bees with [ colonyID = InspectTurtle ] = 0 and count Colonies > 0) [ set InspectTurtle [ who ] of one-of colonies ] if any? turtles with [ who = InspectTurtle ] and count Colonies > 0 [ if ([ breed ] of turtle InspectTurtle != Colonies) [ set InspectTurtle [ who ] of one-of colonies ] ] let continueWorking true tick ; UpdateMorning_Proc without UpdateSeasonalEventsProc [MORN-06] (step 7) if AssertionViolated [ ask patches [ set pcolor red ] user-message "Assertion violated!" ] set Day round (ticks mod 365.00000001) if ticks > 0 and (Day < 1 or Day > 365) [ AssertionProc "Error in calculation of Day! (Updates_Proc)" ] set Date DateREP if Day > 0 [ set DailyForagingPeriod_s Foraging_PeriodREP ] UpdateFoodsourcesProc ; UpdateSeasonalEventsProc: step 7, not run EmergenceNewQueensProc let randomTimeToGetUp_s 1800 set ActiveBeesSortedList [] ask bees with [ (caste = "worker" or caste = "queen") and (activity != "hibernate") and stage = "adult" ] [ set personalTime_s GetUpTime_s + random randomTimeToGetUp_s set activityList [ ] set ActiveBeesSortedList fput who ActiveBeesSortedList ] set ActiveBeesSortedList sort-by [[personalTime_s] of bee ?1 < [personalTime_s] of bee ?2] ActiveBeesSortedList if Day = 365 and length CropRotationList > 1 [ CropRotationProc ] UpdateColoniesProc UpdateColonyStoreBarsProc CheckNumbersProc NeedNectarPollenLarvaeTodayProc while [ continueWorking = true and count bees with [ (caste = "worker" or caste = "queen") and (activity != "hibernate") and stage = "adult" ] > 0 and count colonies > 0 ] [ set ActiveBee NextActiveBeeREP ask bee ActiveBee [ ifelse personalTime_s > CallItaDay_s [ set continueWorking false ] [ set Daytime_s personalTime_s ifelse (floor (remainder personalTime_s 3600) / 60) >= 10 [ set activityList lput ( word floor (personalTime_s / 3600) ":" floor ((remainder personalTime_s 3600) / 60)) activityList ] [ set activityList lput ( word floor (personalTime_s / 3600) ":0" floor ((remainder personalTime_s 3600) / 60)) activityList ] ActivityProc ] if colonyID = -1 [ set personalTime_s CallItaDay_s + 1 ] ] ] ask bees with [ stage = "adult" and activity != "hibernate" and caste != "male" ] [ set activity "resting" set activityList lput "End" activityList ] ; QueensLeavingNestProc [GO-12]: step 7, not run FeedLarvaeProc QueenProductionDateProc DevelopmentProc MortalityBroodProc BadgersOnTheProwlProc OutputDailyProc if ShowCohorts? = true [ DrawCohortsProc ] if count Colonies + count Bees = 0 [ if TimeToExtinction <= 0 [ set TimeToExtinction ticks ] set Survived? 0 if StopExtinct? = true [ stop ] ]
